verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own docs clearly document passwordless sign-in via FIDO2 passkeys, Microsoft Authenticator, and platform-stored passkeys as a first-class, supported flow (microsoft-entra-docs-6,7,20,21). However, independent security research reported a concrete downgrade attack that can bypass FIDO/passkey auth in Entra ID by exploiting coexisting fallback methods, and practitioners describe having to add extra network-layer mitigations because of it — a documented case where the passwordless flow doesn't hold up as claimed in practice. missing for 10: evidence Microsoft has fully closed the downgrade-attack vector, and independent hands-on confirmation of smooth passkey enrollment/sign-in outside official docs.
